title: INTRA: Interleaved Non-contiguous Token spaRse Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.34056v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformers achieve strong performance across modalities but are bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of attention. Sparse attention can reduce this cost, but effective sparsity must preserve useful long-range communication and map well to GPU hardware. We introduce INTRA--Interleaved Non-contiguous Token spaRse Attention--a hardware-aware static sparse attention design based on a relay-communication view under Computational Query Set (CQS) constraints. Rather than directly covering all token-to-token interactions within each sparse layer, INTRA uses complementary sparse groups to provide short mediated communication paths across layers. Scatter forms relay groups that sample broadly across local neighborhoods, while Gather reconnects these groups in subsequent layers. Under a partition model, this structure guides CQS-compatible sparse patterns with global reachability. Our CQS-aware FlashAttention-style kernel computes structured indice

translated_title: INTRA：交错非连续Token稀疏注意力
translated_abstract: Transformers 在多种模态上都取得了强大的性能，但受到注意力机制二次方计算成本的瓶颈限制。稀疏注意力可以降低这一成本，但有效的稀疏性必须保留有用的长程通信，并能良好地映射到 GPU 硬件上。我们提出了 INTRA——交错非连续Token稀疏注意力——这是一种在计算查询集约束下、基于中继通信视角的硬件感知静态稀疏注意力设计。INTRA 并不直接覆盖每个稀疏层内所有的 token 间交互，而是使用互补的稀疏组来提供跨层的短中介通信路径。Scatter 形成在局部邻域内广泛采样的中继组，而 Gather 则在后续层中重新连接这些组。在划分模型下，这种结构引导出具有全局可达性的 CQS 兼容稀疏模式。我们的 CQS 感知 FlashAttention 风格内核可计算结构化索引……
tldr: INTRA 提出了一种硬件感知的静态稀疏注意力设计，通过 Scatter 和 Gather 互补稀疏组在层间建立中继通信路径，在保留全局长程信息交互的同时高效兼容 GPU 硬件，从而突破注意力二次方计算成本的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: INTRA is a hardware-aware static sparse attention design that uses complementary Scatter and Gather sparse groups to build relay communication paths across layers, preserving long-range global interactions while efficiently mapping to GPU hardware.
